title: Ownership (Part 1) - Moves and borrowed reads
learning_objectives: Explain what it means for a `String` value to move into a function.
Use `&str` when a helper only needs to read text.
Recognize the compiler error caused by using a value after it has moved.
explanation: This first ownership slice contrasts two choices: moving a `String` into a function or borrowing it for a read-only task. The goal is to understand why a borrowed `&str` keeps the original owner usable after the helper returns.

examples.title: Passing ownership moves the value
Borrow text for repeated reads

completion_criteria: Exercise tests pass while the original `String` remains usable
Learner can explain why borrowing `&str` avoids moving ownership into the helper
